parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end of the time range to query. The value is a UNIX timestamp in seconds.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page.

parameters.name: ServiceName
parameters.description: The name of the application for an exact match. If you do not specify this parameter, all applications are queried.

parameters.name: ServiceNameFuzzy
parameters.description: The name of the application for a fuzzy match. If you do not specify this parameter, all applications are queried.

parameters.name: SourceIp
parameters.description: The source IP address of the visitor.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The start of the time range to query. The value is a UNIX timestamp in seconds.
